goal: Support macOS and Windows with verified path handling, config overrides, and media export workflows.

notes: Path handling, config normalization, ffmpeg subtitle filter escaping, and lightweight CLI validation are implemented.
macOS Apple Silicon smoke verification passed for chapter 0 of 《亵渎》 across wav, mp3, mp4, and mp4 with subtitle burn-in.
The exported subtitle video path completed with tmp -> mp4 replacement and cleaned intermediate wav/srt files.
Windows-specific filename sanitization, reserved-name handling, and subtitle filter escaping are implemented with unit coverage.
True runtime verification on a drive-letter path with ffmpeg/libass is still pending.

tracks.title: Constrain declared support boundary
notes: Updated requires-python to >=3.11,<3.13 in pyproject.toml.
README now separates verified macOS support from planned Windows support.

tracks.title: Decouple display titles from filesystem-safe output paths
notes: Added src/pathing.py with Windows-invalid character sanitization and reserved-name handling.
Output targets now use sanitized relative paths while TOC display text remains unchanged.
Collisions after sanitization now get deterministic numeric suffixes.

tracks.title: Use Path-driven derived output files
notes: Converted tmp/media/subtitle/cover path derivation to Path-based helpers.
Atomic write behavior remains tmp -> move/replace.

tracks.title: Normalize config paths and refresh runtime overrides
notes: Added normalize_config_paths() and re-run it after CLI overrides.
Runtime globals now refresh for resources/output/model/speaker/prompt settings.

tracks.title: Harden ffmpeg subtitle filter path escaping
notes: Added a dedicated subtitles filter builder in src/ffmpeg_filters.py and wired it into src/video.py.
Normalize subtitle paths to forward-slash form before escaping.
Escape filename/style values for both ffmpeg option parsing and filtergraph parsing.
Added unit coverage for Windows drive letters, spaces, quotes, brackets, commas, and semicolons.

tracks.title: Remove Python compatibility warnings
notes: Fixed invalid escape sequence in get_delimiter_pattern().
compileall no longer reports that warning.

tracks.title: Add repeatable verification
notes: Added unittest coverage for path sanitization and runtime path resolution.
Added unittest coverage for ffmpeg subtitles filter escaping.
Added unittest coverage for the lightweight validation mode.
Verified compileall and `uv run txt2audio --dump-config --json` in the current workspace.
Verified the CLI-level `--validate-paths` mode end-to-end without loading the TTS model.
Verified macOS Apple Silicon media generation on chapter 0 of 《亵渎》 for wav, mp3, mp4, and mp4+subtitles.
Windows media generation smoke runs for wav/mp3/mp4/mp4+subtitles are still pending.

latest_work: Added src/pathing.py and switched main output/media path derivation to it.
Normalized config paths after runtime overrides and refreshed module globals.
Constrained requires-python to >=3.11,<3.13 and updated README support boundaries.
Added src/ffmpeg_filters.py and wired subtitle burn-in through a dedicated escaping helper.
Added a lightweight --validate-paths CLI mode and deferred heavy imports so path validation stays fast.
Verified compileall, unittest coverage, config dump, and CLI path validation in the current workspace.
Ran a real macOS Apple Silicon smoke test on chapter 0 of 《亵渎》 and confirmed wav, mp3, mp4, and mp4 subtitle burn-in outputs.
known_open_risks: Windows x64 runtime verification is still missing for actual media generation, drive-letter paths, and subtitle burn-in with ffmpeg/libass.

next_step.title: Run real media smoke tests on Windows x64
next_step.why: macOS media generation has been verified locally, so the remaining platform risk is Windows runtime behavior for TTS generation, ffmpeg conversion, and subtitle burn-in on drive-letter paths.
windows_focus: Use output directories with spaces and Chinese characters.
